sents.zh: 今天老师带我们去看书的地方。
sents.en: Today the teacher took us to the place with the books.
It was large, and no one was talking.
Inside there were a great many books.

sents.zh: 有的书很新，有的书很旧。
sents.en: Some books were new, some were old.

sents.zh: 我找到了一本很久以前的故事书。
sents.en: I found a story book about long ago.
I sat down and began to read.

sents.zh: 书里有大王，有长城，也有马。
sents.en: In the book there were kings, the Great Wall, and horses.
I read for a long time and forgot the time.
The teacher said: "It is time to go back to school."
I took three books home with me.
